fact: Maliweb reports that Orange Corners Mali, implemented by DoniLab, held a DemoDay on 30 June 2026 closing a six-month incubation and acceleration programme for its fourth cohort of 21 young entrepreneurs from Bamako, Segou and Sikasso, whose projects were agri-food, livestock, tricycle transport, parcel delivery and arboriculture.

AfriLabs lists eight Malian member hubs; the Mali Business Innovation and Incubation Centre (Nyetaa Mali) is said to support young innovators through its incubation programs and DoniLab is described as a business incubator.

Mali's Ministry of Communication and Digital Economy launched the Mali Digital Accélérateur, a programme offering startups training, mentoring, financial support and investor networking, with no cohort of startups named.
